packageRules.description: The stack spikes (ADR 0001) are kept for reference only: the workspace excludes them and CI never builds them, so no update to them can be proven, and their dependencies (tauri among them) are not the app's.

windows-core and windows-numerics are pinned to the versions `windows` itself depends on (Cargo.toml): Direct2D takes `windows_numerics` types and `#[implement]` expands to `::windows_core` paths, so a newer one on its own gives the build a second copy whose types do not match. They move by hand together with `windows` (next rule).
Reminds whoever takes a `windows` update to move its two pinned companions with it.
prBodyNotes: Move `windows-core` and `windows-numerics` in Cargo.toml to the versions this `windows` release depends on (see its entry in Cargo.lock). Renovate does not update them on their own (renovate.json).
